tag: 入住選房並詢問延後退房

level.why: 兩人短對話，房型條件與請求都以簡單句直接說出，搭配一張簡單房價表即可作答。

dialogue.t: Welcome to the Harbor Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us tonight?
dialogue.zh: 歡迎光臨港灣飯店。請問您今晚有預約嗎？

dialogue.t: No, I don't. I need a room for two nights for my sister and me.
dialogue.zh: 沒有。我需要一間房住兩晚，給我姊姊和我。

dialogue.t: We have several room types today. Which one would you like to see first?
dialogue.zh: 我們今天有好幾種房型。您想先看哪一種？

dialogue.t: We need two beds, and we can't pay more than one hundred twenty-five dollars a night.
dialogue.zh: 我們需要兩張床，而且一晚不能超過一百二十五美元。

dialogue.t: I see. Only one of our rooms has two beds at that price, and breakfast is included.
dialogue.zh: 了解。在那個價位下只有一種房型有兩張床，而且含早餐。

dialogue.t: Perfect. Could I also have a late checkout on Sunday? Our train leaves in the evening.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我週日可以延後退房嗎？我們的火車傍晚才開。

dialogue.t: Let me ask my manager. I'll call your room in a few minutes with an answer.
dialogue.zh: 我去問一下經理。幾分鐘後會打電話到您房間回覆。

q.t: Look at the graphic. Which floor will the women's room most likely be on?
q.zh: 請看圖表。這兩位女士的房間最可能在幾樓？

choices.t: The 3rd floor
choices.why: Standard 價格符合預算，但只有一張床，不符「兩張床」。

choices.t: The 5th floor
choices.why: 需要兩張床且不超過 125 美元，只有 Deluxe（$120、兩張床）符合，位於 5 樓。

choices.t: The 7th floor
choices.why: Family 有兩張床，但 $160 超過預算。

choices.t: The 8th floor
choices.why: Suite 只有一張床且 $180 超出預算，是把樓層與房型混淆。

q.t: Why does the woman say, "Our train leaves in the evening"?
q.zh: 女士為什麼說「我們的火車傍晚才開」？

choices.t: She wants to leave the hotel later than usual.
choices.zh: 她想比平常晚一點離開飯店。
choices.why: 她先問能否延後退房，再說明火車傍晚才開作為理由。

choices.t: She wants to ask the way to the train station.
choices.why: 對話提到火車，但她沒有問路。

choices.t: She wants to check out earlier than planned.
choices.zh: 她想比原訂時間更早退房。
choices.why: 她要的是延後退房，與提早相反。

choices.t: She wants to complain about the room price.
choices.why: 她對房價沒有抱怨，還說「Perfect」。

q.t: What will the man most likely do next?
q.zh: 這位男士接下來最可能做什麼？

choices.t: Talk to his supervisor about her request
choices.zh: 就她的請求詢問他的主管
choices.why: 他說 Let me ask my manager，manager 即主管。

choices.t: Show her the different room types
choices.why: 他先前問過想先看哪一種，但後來已確定房型，不是接下來的動作。

choices.t: Call a taxi to the train station
choices.why: 對話完全沒有提到叫車。

choices.t: Bring breakfast up to her room
choices.why: 只提到含早餐，他說要打電話到房間回覆，不是送早餐。

level.why: 室友間的日常分工對話，句子簡短，答案幾乎照字面出現。

dialogue.t: My parents are visiting this Saturday, so we should clean the apartment tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我爸媽這個週六會來，所以我們今晚該打掃公寓。

dialogue.t: Good idea. I can vacuum the living room and wash the windows after dinner.
dialogue.zh: 好主意。我晚餐後可以吸客廳的地並擦窗戶。

dialogue.t: Thanks. I'll tidy the guest room and put fresh sheets on the sofa bed.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。我會整理客房，並在沙發床上鋪乾淨的床單。

dialogue.t: Do you want me to buy some fruit and flowers on my way home?
dialogue.zh: 要不要我回家路上買些水果和花？

dialogue.t: Yes, please. Just get some apples and a small bunch of roses.
dialogue.zh: 好，麻煩你。買一些蘋果和一小束玫瑰就好。

dialogue.t: Okay. Oh, the kitchen sink is dripping again. Should I call the landlord?
dialogue.zh: 好。對了，廚房水槽又在滴水了。我要打給房東嗎？

dialogue.t: Don't worry. I already sent him a message this morning, and he said he'd come on Friday.
dialogue.zh: 別擔心。我今早已傳訊息給他，他說週五會來。

q.t: What are the speakers mainly discussing?
q.zh: 兩位說話者主要在討論什麼？

choices.t: Preparing for a family visit
choices.why: 全段圍繞父母週六來訪前的打掃與採買。

choices.t: Moving to a new apartment
choices.why: 對話只談打掃現在的公寓，沒有搬家。

choices.t: Repairing a kitchen sink
choices.why: 水槽只在後段順帶一提，不是主題。

choices.t: Planning a dinner party for friends
choices.why: 訪客是父母，且沒有提到晚宴；只有提到晚餐後打掃。

q.t: What will the man buy on his way home?
q.zh: 這位男士回家路上會買什麼？

choices.t: Some fruit and flowers
choices.why: 女士要他買蘋果與玫瑰，即水果和花。

choices.t: Fresh sheets for the sofa bed
choices.why: 鋪床單的是女士，且不是要買的東西。

choices.t: Food for Saturday's dinner
choices.why: 對話沒有提到要買晚餐食材。

choices.t: A new kitchen sink
choices.why: 水槽只是在說滴水問題，沒人說要買。

q.t: What can be inferred about the kitchen sink?
q.zh: 關於廚房水槽可以推論出什麼？

choices.t: It will probably be fixed before the parents arrive.
choices.zh: 它可能會在父母抵達前修好。
choices.why: 房東週五會來，而父母週六才到。

choices.t: The man has already repaired it himself.
choices.zh: 這位男士已自己修好了。
choices.why: 男士只是詢問要不要聯絡房東，並沒有修。

choices.t: The woman plans to fix it herself.
choices.why: 她已請房東處理，並不打算自己修。

choices.t: It stopped dripping this morning.
choices.zh: 它今天早上已停止滴水。
choices.why: 「今早」是女士傳訊息的時間，水槽仍在滴水。
